subject: CAIQ live audit: runtime evidence bundle + on-demand demo instructions
messages:
From: SigmaAudit <sig-audit@sigmaaudit.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Martin <alice.martin@prospecthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ runtime controls — evidence and live demo request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for coordinating with Prospect Health. As part of our CAIQ review for Prospect Health's procurement, we need runtime‑level evidence for the following control families: CCM-Data Security, CCM-Identity & Access, CCM-Operations & Resilience. Specifically, please provide:

- System architecture diagram showing network segmentation and control points (PNG/PDF)
- CAIQ answer sheet (the latest signed PDF)
- Access log extracts for the last 90 days (redacted for PII acceptable)
- Runtime trace logs demonstrating request authentication and token handling (samples)
- KV cache eviction and prefix cache examples for a 24‑hour window (timestamped)
- Deployment manifests and image hashes for the environment used by Prospect Health
- A short runbook for an on‑demand live demo (10–15 minutes) showing control enforcement and audit trails

We prefer a single zipped bundle uploaded to a shared drive. Can you confirm: (a) an estimated delivery time, (b) a Drive link with access controls, and (c) availability windows for a 30‑minute live demo next week (US/PST).

Thanks — happy to take a quick call if that is easier.

Best,
Sam Ellis
SigmaAudit — Senior Assessor
From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Martin <alice.martin@prospecthealth.com>, SigmaAudit <sig-audit@sigmaaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ runtime controls — evidence and live demo request

Team — forwarding Sam's request from SigmaAudit (external). Prospect Health needs runtime evidence and a short live demo. Please see the list of artifacts Sam requested below.

Action items:
- Marcus: please assemble infra artifacts (architecture diagram, deployment manifests, image hashes, KV/cache samples).
- Rishi: prepare the CAIQ answers plus control mapping and access log extracts; confirm redaction approach for PII.
- Naomi: coordinate demo runbook and customer scheduling; you'll lead the demo with Marcus on infra.

Target: get a zipped evidence bundle uploaded to the shared Drive by EOD Monday PST. Auditor prefers a single ZIP with an evidence_manifest.csv listing file provenance and owner. Notify me when uploads are available and paste the Drive link.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CAIQ runtime controls — evidence and live demo request

All — assigning owners and outlining the bundle contents. I'll own the infra artifact collection and the final packaging. Plan below:

Bundle contents (expected filenames):
- redwood_runtime_architecture.png (Marc) — includes network flow and control points
- deployment_manifests_PH_env.yaml (Marc) — K8s manifests for PH staging cluster
- image_hashes_PH_env.txt (Marc) — digests and release tags
- access_logs_202608-202610_redacted.tar.gz (Rishi) — access logs, redacted per policy
- runtime_traces_sample_20261015.jsonl (Marc) — 3 anonymized trace records showing auth flow
- kv_cache_eviction_20261015.csv (Marc) — eviction timestamps and TTLs (no keys)
- caiq_answer_sheet_2026-10-20.pdf (Rishi) — finalized answers
- evidence_manifest.csv (Marc) — provenance, owner, retrieval method
- demo_runbook.md (Naomi) — step list and commands for the live demo

Packaging notes: remove PII, keep hashes/timestamps, and include short readme.txt for each artifact explaining scope and redaction. I'll produce evidence_package_v1.zip and upload to the shared Drive at the link below.

Proposed demo windows (PST): Mon 10/26 10:00–11:30, Tue 10/27 14:00–15:30. Naomi — can you confirm customer availability?

Drive upload target: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleDriveLink (will set view-only for auditors, editors for owners).

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Martin <alice.martin@prospecthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CAIQ runtime controls — evidence and live demo request

Quick update: Prospect Health confirmed Tue 10/27 14:00–14:30 PST for the live demo. I'll run the demo and cover observability + access logs; Marcus will show the infra artifacts and runtime traces. Rishi — please ensure the access_logs_202608-202610_redacted.tar.gz is uploaded and that the manifest references the exact log paths.

I have prepared a short demo_runbook.md that walks through the following script:
1) Intro and scope (2 min)
2) Show architecture diagram and deployment manifests (3 min)
3) Live replay of a sampled request flow showing auth token validation and logging (6 min)
4) Show evidence manifest and how auditors can map files to CAIQ controls (3 min)

I'll scrub any customer identifiers from the replay. Will upload demo_runbook.md and drop the Drive link once Marcus uploads the package.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: SigmaAudit <sig-audit@sigmaaudit.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Martin <alice.martin@prospecthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime controls — evidence and live demo request

Soojin/Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear plan. We have view access to the Drive folder you linked and see the following files: caiq_answer_sheet_2026-10-20.pdf, redwood_runtime_architecture.png, evidence_manifest.csv, demo_runbook.md. We could not locate evidence_package_v1.zip in the root; if you prefer uploading the unzipped artifacts and a CSV manifest that's fine — just confirm retrieval method.

We'd also like a short CAIQ control mapping sheet that maps each file to CSA CCM control IDs (e.g., CCM-Data-1, CCM-Identity-5). If you can add a simple mapping CSV (file_name, control_id, control_description, owner) before the demo, that will speed our review.

Demo confirmed for Tue 10/27 14:00 PST. Please include a dial-in (we will use a Zoom link).

Regards,
Sam Ellis
SigmaAudit — Senior Assessor
